description:
The food.gdt dataset is open in Gretl. It contains real household survey data with two variables: 'food_exp' (weekly food expenditure in dollars) and 'income' (weekly income in $100 units) for 40 households.

Add a new variable that is the natural log of 'food_exp'. Use the menu: Add > Logs of selected variables. In the main window, first click on 'food_exp' to select it, then go to Add > Logs of selected variables. This will create a new variable named 'l_food_exp' in the dataset. After the variable is created (you should see it in the variable list on the left), save the modified dataset to /home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/food_with_log.gdt using File > Save data as (choose gretl data format .gdt).

metadata.data_source: Hill, Griffiths, Lim - Principles of Econometrics 5th ed, household survey data
